reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate FarmBot
reauth_confirm.description: Your FarmBot token has expired or authentication failed. Please sign in again to continue. Device: {device_id}

error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different FarmBot.

init.title: FarmBot Vision bridge options
init.description: These options control the optional bridge to a separate FarmBot Vision app. FarmBot credentials are never re-entered here.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot to run the sequence on.

move_to.name: Move to
move_to.description: Move to X/Y/Z coordinates. At least one of X, Y or Z must be supplied.

list_vision_bots.name: List Vision bots
list_vision_bots.description: Return the loaded FarmBot config entries available to the FarmBot Vision bridge. Never includes credentials.

get_vision_inventory.name: Get Vision inventory
get_vision_inventory.description: Return a snapshot of active plants, recently processed image metadata, and relevant spread curves for one FarmBot.

image_lookback_hours.name: Image lookback (hours)
image_lookback_hours.description: Only include images created within this many hours. Default 72, maximum 336 (14 days).

include_all_curves.name: Include all curves
include_all_curves.description: Return every spread curve, not just ones assigned to returned plants or owned by FarmBot Vision.

get_vision_image.name: Get Vision image
get_vision_image.description: Download, EXIF-correct, resize and return one FarmBot image as a base64-encoded JPEG, with scaling metadata and rescaled camera calibration. sha256 is the hash of the returned JPEG (source_sha256 optionally covers the original download).

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot the image belongs to.

image_id.name: Image ID
image_id.description: ID of the FarmBot image to fetch.

max_width.name: Max width
max_width.description: Output bounding-box width in pixels; the image is fitted inside it without upscaling. Default 640 (e.g. 640, 960 or 1280 for common analysis resolutions). Max 4096.

max_height.name: Max height
max_height.description: Output bounding-box height in pixels; the image is fitted inside it without upscaling. Default 480 (e.g. 480, 720 or 960). Max 4096.

get_vision_soil_points.name: Get Vision soil points
get_vision_soil_points.description: Return recognized active soil-height GenericPointers and the FarmBot motion state.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot whose soil points should be returned.

start_vision_soil_capture.name: Start Vision soil capture
start_vision_soil_capture.description: Queue an illuminated virtual-stereo soil capture with per-frame position, upload, exposure, blur, and five-attempt retry validation.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that should capture the images.

point_id.name: Soil point ID
point_id.description: Optional recognized soil point. Omit it for a custom-coordinate calibration capture.

capture_x.name: Clear-soil X
capture_x.description: Clear-soil capture X. Required when no soil point is supplied; otherwise relocation is limited to 200 mm.

capture_y.name: Clear-soil Y
capture_y.description: Optional clear-soil capture Y, supplied together with clear-soil X.

capture_z.name: Capture Z
capture_z.description: Camera Z coordinate for the lateral image triplet.

baseline_mm.name: Baseline
baseline_mm.description: Lateral separation in millimetres; 15 mm is recommended.

z_offsets_mm.name: Z offsets
z_offsets_mm.description: Use [0] for measurement or [0, 25, 50] for guided calibration.

get_vision_soil_capture.name: Get Vision soil capture
get_vision_soil_capture.description: Return status and completed image frames for a soil capture.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that owns the capture.

capture_id.name: Capture ID
capture_id.description: UUID returned by Start Vision soil capture.

start_vision_grid_repair.name: Start Vision photo-grid repair
start_vision_grid_repair.description: Queue safe, bounded moves that retake missing or invalid photo-grid cells.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that should retake the images.

targets.name: Repair targets
targets.description: One to twelve objects containing X, Y and Z coordinates.

get_vision_grid_repair.name: Get Vision photo-grid repair
get_vision_grid_repair.description: Return the status of a queued photo-grid repair.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that owns the repair.

repair_id.name: Repair ID
repair_id.description: UUID returned by Start Vision photo-grid repair.

delete_vision_image.name: Delete Vision image
delete_vision_image.description: Permanently delete one image owned by this FarmBot. Used to retire a photo-grid frame that a repair has already replaced with a better photo of the same cell.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that owns the image.

apply_vision_soil_height.name: Apply Vision soil height
apply_vision_soil_height.description: Revalidate and replace a stale soil point with a reviewed clear-soil X, Y and Z measurement.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that owns the soil point.

point_id.name: Soil point ID
point_id.description: ID of the existing soil-height GenericPointer.

measurement_id.name: Measurement ID
measurement_id.description: UUID of the reviewed FarmBot Vision result.

expected_updated_at.name: Expected update date
expected_updated_at.description: Point update timestamp recorded when the clear site was planned.

recommended_x.name: Recommended X
recommended_x.description: Reviewed clear-soil X, less than 200 mm from the stale point.

recommended_y.name: Recommended Y
recommended_y.description: Reviewed clear-soil Y, less than 200 mm from the stale point.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: If off, perform validation without writing.

human_approved.name: Human approved
human_approved.description: Must be on for a soil-height write.

apply_vision_radius.name: Apply Vision radius
apply_vision_radius.description: Validate (and optionally apply) a FarmBot Vision plant-radius recommendation. The integration independently re-verifies plant identity and that the current radius matches expectations before writing anything; radius limits and confidence thresholds are the FarmBot Vision app's responsibility.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot the plant belongs to.

plant_id.name: Plant ID
plant_id.description: FarmBot point ID of the plant.

measurement_id.name: Measurement ID
measurement_id.description: UUID identifying this specific recommendation, for idempotency and logging.

expected_current_radius_mm.name: Expected current radius (mm)
expected_current_radius_mm.description: The radius, in millimetres, the app believes the plant currently has. Rejected if it no longer matches FarmBot.

recommended_radius_mm.name: Recommended radius (mm)
recommended_radius_mm.description: The new plant radius in millimetres (a radius, not a spread-curve diameter).

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: If off (default), only validates and returns a dry-run result. If on, applies the change.

human_approved.name: Human approved
human_approved.description: Marks this as a deliberate human approval, for logging. It never bypasses validation and safety checks.

apply_vision_removal.name: Apply Vision removal
apply_vision_removal.description: Validate and optionally mark a vision-confirmed missing plant as removed. This is reversible: the FarmBot point is patched, never deleted.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot the plant belongs to.

plant_id.name: Plant ID
plant_id.description: FarmBot point ID of the plant.

expected_current_radius_mm.name: Expected current radius (mm)
expected_current_radius_mm.description: The radius recorded when the absence was observed. Rejected if the plant has changed since then.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: If off (default), only validates and returns a dry-run result.

human_approved.name: Human approved
human_approved.description: Marks this as a deliberate human approval, for logging. It never bypasses validation.

upsert_vision_spread_curve.name: Upsert Vision spread curve
upsert_vision_spread_curve.description: Create or update a FarmBot Vision-owned spread curve and optionally assign it to plants.

crop_slug.name: Crop slug
crop_slug.description: OpenFarm crop slug this curve is for.

curve_id.name: Curve ID
curve_id.description: ID of an existing FarmBot Vision-owned spread curve to update. Leave empty to create a new curve.

name.name: Name
name.description: Curve name; must start with "[FarmBot Vision]".

data.name: Curve data
data.description: Mapping of day number to plant diameter in millimetres (not radius). Up to 10 points, strictly increasing days, non-decreasing diameters.

assign_to_plant_ids.name: Assign to plants
assign_to_plant_ids.description: Plant IDs to assign the resulting curve to once validated.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: If off (default), only validates and returns a dry-run result.

human_approved.name: Human approved
human_approved.description: Marks this as a deliberate human approval, for logging. It never bypasses validation or ownership checks.

report_vision_status.name: Report Vision status
report_vision_status.description: Report FarmBot Vision app status (heartbeat) for display on Home Assistant entities.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot this status report is for.

available.name: Available
available.description: Whether the FarmBot Vision app itself reports being available.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: Identifier of the current or most recent analysis job.

last_completed_at.name: Last completed at
last_completed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last completed analysis.

plants_analysed.name: Plants analysed
plants_analysed.description: Number of plants analysed in the last run.

uncertain.name: Uncertain
uncertain.description: Number of plants the analysis was uncertain about.

request_vision_analysis.name: Request Vision analysis
request_vision_analysis.description: Fire a farmbot_vision_request event asking the FarmBot Vision app to run an analysis. Does not connect to the app directly.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot to request analysis for.

plant_ids.name: Plant IDs
plant_ids.description: Optional list of plant IDs to limit the analysis to.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Analysis mode: observe, recommend, or auto_radius.

start_vision_gcode.name: Start Vision raw G-code (experimental)
start_vision_gcode.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Send raw firmware G-code straight to the Farmduino, bypassing FarmBot OS motion planning. The integration validates and bounds-checks the whole program before any of it is sent.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot to run the program on.

lines.name: G-code lines
lines.description: The program, one line per entry. Supported: G21, G90, G91, G00 (X/Y/Z/F/A/B/C) and a standalone F.

feed_mm_per_min.name: Feed rate
feed_mm_per_min.description: Default travel speed in mm/min, used for any move that does not set F itself.

return_to_start.name: Return to start
return_to_start.description: Move back to the starting position (through FarmBot OS, with safe Z) when the program ends.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Validate the program and report what it would do without moving.

acknowledge_experimental.name: Acknowledge experimental
acknowledge_experimental.description: Must be true. Raw G-code bypasses FarmBot OS safety handling.

get_vision_gcode.name: Get Vision raw G-code run
get_vision_gcode.description: Return the status of a queued raw G-code run.

config_entry_id.name: FarmBot
config_entry_id.description: The FarmBot that owns the run.

run_id.name: Run ID
run_id.description: UUID returned by Start Vision raw G-code.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: FarmBot config entry "{config_entry_id}" is not loaded.

farmbot_auth_error.message: FarmBot rejected the current credentials; reauthentication has been triggered.

farmbot_api_error.message: FarmBot API request failed. See the Home Assistant log for details.

vision_image_wrong_device.message: That image does not belong to this FarmBot.

vision_image_not_processed.message: FarmBot has not finished processing that image yet.

vision_image_no_attachment.message: That image has no downloadable attachment.

vision_image_decode_failed.message: The downloaded image could not be decoded.

vision_unexpected_error.message: The FarmBot Vision request failed unexpectedly. See the Home Assistant log for details.

vision_curve_assignment_invalid.message: Cannot assign the curve to plant {plant_id}: {reason}.
